bottleneck.description: Wafer probe cards — dominant in HBM probe-card segment; the AI-memory ramp leverages this position as the highest-value subsegment of test infrastructure.

dependency.key_customers: Micron, SK Hynix, Samsung (HBM test); leading-edge logic test customers

editorial.notes: Probe cards are a 3-supplier market (FormFactor, MJC, Technoprobe). FormFactor's HBM probe-card position is leveraged by the AI-memory ramp — HBM cards have multi-quarter qualification timelines, making mid-program switching impractical. Revised from MEDIUM given the HBM-specific dominance in the highest-value test segment.
